# tool-registry

> Versioned registry of agent tools with a bounded JSON Schema subset validator, semver resolution, permission checks before every call and MCP-shaped export Python package `trysac-tool-registry`, import name `tool_registry`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
